label: AI Insight UI — Deploy
info:
Standard FAP deploy endpoint for the AI Insight UI bundle.

Receives a built Vite SPA (zip) at POST /backendtest/aiInsight, persists it,
extracts it into /data/uibuilder/aiInsight/src/, and runs a defensive sed to
ensure asset paths resolve under the served URL (/orce/aiInsight/...). The
sed pattern is a no-op when Vite was built with `base: '/orce/aiInsight/'`
(which is the source-of-truth default in vite.config.ts).

Auth: Bearer token validated against env var FACIS_DEPLOY_TOKEN. Operators set
the token via Helm values or `kubectl set env` and provide it in CI as
$FACIS_DEPLOY_TOKEN.

FAP Guideline reference: pattern adapted from the reference example flow at
guidelines and examples/flows.json (Atlas workspace root).

name: validate bearer token
write upload data
build unzip command
func:
const name = msg.uibuildername;
msg.command =
    `sh -c 'set -e; ZIP="/data/uibuilder/aiInsight-bundle.zip"; ` +
    `DST="/data/uibuilder/${name}/src"; ` +
    `TMP="$(mktemp -d)"; ` +
    `mkdir -p "$DST"; ` +
    `unzip -q -o "$ZIP" -d "$TMP"; ` +
    `SRC="$TMP/dist"; [ -d "$SRC" ] || SRC="$TMP"; ` +
    `rm -rf "$DST"/*; ` +
    `cp -a "$SRC"/. "$DST"/; ` +
    `chmod -R u+rw,g+rw,o+rw "$DST"; ` +
    `rm -rf "$TMP"'`;
return msg;
